subject: Hands-on pilot kickoff — Aligning prompts, routing, and load plan

Subject: Hands-on pilot kickoff — draft agenda and proposed slots

Hi Claire & Samir,

Thanks again for the great meeting last week. As discussed, we'd like to lock a 90-minute hands-on kickoff to:

- Introduce stakeholders and success criteria
- Walk through initial prompt sets and routing rules
- Run a short routing demo and confirm fallback behaviors
- Validate a simple load test (targeting 50 concurrent sessions)

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Wed Mar 18, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Mar 19, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Fri Mar 20, 09:00–10:30 PT

I've attached a draft agenda and a sample routing JSON for reference. Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will be the primary technical lead?

Attachments: [Attachment: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [Attachment: routing-config-example.json (JSON, 6KB)]

Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hands-on pilot kickoff — draft agenda and proposed slots

Claire — thanks for the note. We will add a 20-minute latency/cache deep-dive.

Quick tech preview so Samir knows what we'll cover:
- Prompt review: tokenization, stop sequences, and expected avg token lengths (we'll bring a small sample set)
- Routing: primary model -> reranker -> fallback model; show routing policy config and live metrics
- Caching: prefix/KV behavior and TTL tuning to avoid stale reranks
- Load test: plan to run a 10-minute ramp to 50 concurrent sessions using our in-house harness; we'll surface per-token latency and 95th pct tail.

Action items for Orchid before the session:
1) Share 10 representative prompts (redact PII) — upload to the Google doc linked below
2) Confirm Samir's preferred terminal access (SSH key) or if you prefer we run tests from our Hosted env

Link to doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oXkP-POC-Agenda-9876

I'll attach a short load-test plan and the routing JSON for review.

[Attachment: load-test-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)], [Attachment: routing-config-example.json (JSON, 6KB)]

- Dev

Claire

- 10m Introductions & success criteria (Claire, Jordan, Marissa)
- 20m Prompt review (Tech) — bring 10–12 samples (Orchid)

Pre-reads: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf, load-test-plan.xlsx, routing-config-example.json (links in the doc).
